house_book_foundations.description: Teach the model to recognise the Library book across text, audio, image, and 3D cues.
queries: How would you describe the book on the Library shelf to someone who cannot see it?
Which 3D shape best represents the outer form of that Library book?
When the book opens, what sound texture should its audio memory capture?
true_answers: A book is a rectangular object with a spine and stacked paper pages protected by a cover.
modality_hints: Image shows a blocky rectangle with a visible spine; 3D mesh is a slim rectangular prism; audio is the gentle page flutter.
Think in geometry: the mesh exports as a rectangular prism with flat faces.
Listen for the soft paper rustle when pages turn — no loud mechanical sounds.

house_mirror_room_orientation.description: Guide the model through the Mirror Room mirror and its sensory anchors.
queries: Describe the Mirror Room wall mirror so an avatar can imagine it without seeing it.
Which audio cue fits approaching the Mirror Room mirror?
Which alignment keeps the mirror's reflection steady when the avatar tilts their head?
true_answers: The mirror is a tall vertical rectangle with a brushed metal frame and soft glow edges.
modality_hints: Image shows a glowing framed rectangle; 3D mesh keeps the frame slim; video shows light spill.
Audio log captures a gentle chime resonance as you step close.
Remember the PTX kernel keeps the mirror upright by yaw-aligning the reflection.

house_workshop_table.description: Associate the Workshop table with its multisensory details.
queries: Describe the wooden workshop table in the House workspace for someone relying on text and audio.
What colour palette should its image memory emphasise?
Which ambient audio belongs to the table scene?
true_answers: The workshop table is a sturdy wooden rectangle with embedded tool grooves and a central holo projector.
modality_hints: Image shows warm oak planks with teal highlights; 3D mesh keeps the rectangle thick.
Colour memory favours warm oak wood with teal control lights.
Audio bed features soft tool clinks and quiet workshop ambience.
